name: CI

jobs:
  all-succeeded:
    name: All Succeeded
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - test-linux
    - test-non-linux
    - lint
    - test-generated

    steps:
      - name: Check if all jubs succeeded
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}

  test-linux:
    name: Test Linux
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        rust:
          - stable
          - beta
          - nightly
        mb_const_generics:
          - ""
          - "--features const-generics"
        target:
          - x86_64
          - i686
          - sparc64
        include:
          - mb_const_generics: ""
            rust: 1.41.0
            target: x86_64
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - if: matrix.rust == '1.41.0'
        # Rust 1.41 doesn't like modern lock files :(
        run: rm Cargo.lock
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
      - uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          use-cross: ${{ matrix.target != 'x86_64' }}
          command: test
          args: --verbose --features "strict" ${{ matrix.mb_const_generics }} --target ${{ matrix.target }}-unknown-linux-gnu
      - uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          use-cross: ${{ matrix.target != 'x86_64' }}
          command: doc
          args: --features "strict" ${{ matrix.mb_const_generics }} --target ${{ matrix.target }}-unknown-linux-gnu

  test-non-linux:
    name: Test non-Linux
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest
        rust:
          - stable
        mb_const_generics:
          - ""
          - "--features const-generics"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v2
      - run: just test ${{ matrix.mb_const_generics }}

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v2
      - run: just lint

  test-generated:
    name: Test Generated
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v2
      - run: just gen
      - run: git diff --exit-code

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
